description: Displays a source-neutral article message box without importing a source wiki's template vocabulary.

parameters.name: image
parameters.label: Image
parameters.description: Optional native file name without the File: prefix; set to none to hide.

parameters.name: image_content
parameters.label: Image content
parameters.description: Pre-rendered image content such as Template:Preservation image; takes precedence over image.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.label: Image size
parameters.description: Display size for a native image.

parameters.name: small
parameters.label: Small
parameters.description: Render the compact form when set to yes.

parameters.name: plainlinks
parameters.label: Plain links
parameters.description: Set to no to preserve ordinary external-link styling.

documentation_wikitext:
{{SHORTDESC:Article message box template}}
Use this source-neutral template for article notices, maintenance messages, and preserved source messages. Preserve source-authored text; do not invent a message merely to decorate an article.

render_fixtures.invocation: {{Ambox|type=notice|text=This source-authored notice is preserved.|image_content={{Preservation image|site=example-site|sha256=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef|alt=Preserved notice icon|width=40|height=40}}}}
